title: Security: unauthenticated db_path query parameter opens any SQLite file (positions/net, attribution)
note: CODE READ 2026-11-11: src/web/api/routers/attribution.py:60 and :247 accept db_path from the query string (include_in_schema=False) and pass it to sqlite3.connect without mode=ro (attribution.py:75-77, src/runtime/positions.py:326-331). No auth on either route while the site gate is off. Effect: a file-existence probe and a query against any SQLite file the web-api user can open. UNVERIFIED live (not exercised, on purpose). Fix: delete the parameter; tests inject the path another way. Tier 2 (web-api). Same sweep: training_center.py:50 _SAFE_ID accepts '..' (untested traversal on /api/bot/ml/runs).
